Key Features
Modern Vintage Aesthetic: Intricate floral patterns in muted tones blend vintage elegance with contemporary design. Premium soft fibers ensure cloud-like comfort underfoot.
Pet-Safe Low Pile: 0.4” pile resists pet claws and minimizes dirt buildup. Easy to vacuum fur/hair, ideal for households with pets.
TPR Non-Slip Base: Textured backing grips floors securely, reducing tripping risks. Ensure surfaces are dry for optimal adhesion.
Multi-Room Adaptability: Fits living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, dorms, or home offices seamlessly.
Machine-Wash Ready: Cold gentle cycle + air-dry flat. Reverse-roll stored rugs to eliminate fold marks within 72 hours.
